card.line: Thebez was a city north-east of Shechem where the wicked king Abimelech was killed by a woman with a millstone, an event the Bible remembers.

moments.title: Abimelech takes Thebez
moments.text: After the people in the tower of Shechem were killed by fire, Abimelech went to Thebez, camped against it, and captured it. The people fled into a strong tower inside the city.

moments.title: A woman's millstone
moments.text: As Abimelech came to set the tower on fire, a woman dropped an upper millstone on his head. He told his armor-bearer to kill him so no one could say a woman killed him, and he died.
